QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR TIKTOK ADS
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
Is TikTok Ads right for my business?
TikTok works well for B2C brands targeting 18–45 year olds, especially in fashion, beauty, food, fitness, and home. B2B brands can also find success with the right creative approach.
Do I need to create TikTok videos?
Yes — TikTok is a video-first platform. We provide detailed creative briefs and can connect you with content creators if you don't have in-house production capability.
How does TikTok compare to Meta Ads?
TikTok CPMs are typically lower, but creative requirements are higher — you need frequent, native-feeling content. We recommend running both channels in parallel for maximum reach.
